fundamentals.name: Reddit, Inc.
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: Reddit, Inc. operates a digital community in the United States and internationally. The company's platform enables user to engage in conversations, explore passions, research new hobbies, exchange goods and services, create new communities and experiences, share laughs, and find belonging. It also organizes communities based on specific interests that enable users to engage in conversations by sharing experiences, submitting links, uploading images and videos, and replying to one another. Reddit, Inc. was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

judgment.summary: Reddit demonstrates exceptional growth across revenue and earnings, supported by strong margins and a healthy balance sheet.
judgment.earningsRecap: Last quarter beat estimates by 79.1% (EPS 1.01 vs 0.56); next earnings date is 2026-07-30.
positives: Revenue growth 69.1% YoY — indicating strong top-line expansion.
Earnings growth 675.0% YoY and quarterly earnings growth 679.8% — demonstrating significant profitability improvements.
Gross margin 91.4%, Operating margin 27.6%, Profit margin 28.6% — indicating highly efficient operations.
Forward P/E 19.19x — attractive relative to its substantial growth rate.
Total cash $2.77B with minimal debt ($21.29M) — providing substantial financial flexibility.
negatives: Trailing P/E 48.29x — high valuation based on past performance.
Beta 1.85 — indicating higher volatility than the broader market.

news.paragraph: Reddit has seen significant positive momentum following strong earnings and new AI data partnerships, leading to a substantial stock price increase. The company's expansion of its Shopify partnership is expected to boost ad revenue, and its AI strategy is being viewed as a human-centric play in addition to its technological applications. With robust revenue and earnings growth, Reddit appears attractive to investors.
